BH: B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He
content:
# B"H Vision

One Torah universe: Heichel hero from DB name, two living gates into Written and Oral Torah, reader as sacred quiet text, social as midnight glass intelligence.

Not neon everywhere. Identity never hardcoded in renderers. Motion only for entry, focus, press, route. Mobile-first 44px targets. Community one composer. Auto-scroll one river.
